page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal notes in a narrow strip at the left edge (cropped by the scan, mostly unreadable). Page number at the head centre. Signature "H" centred at the foot, catchword "legari" at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: ptura est multis in locis obscura, ambigua &c. Resp. Imò verò, quæcunque ad salutem & Dei gloriam sunt scitu necessaria, ex scripturis prophetiis,& apostolicis perspicuè ac solidè peti & demonstrari possunt. De quare vide plura in loco de scriptura s. & verbo Dei.{26} In generali synodo septima esse definitum, quòd traditiones nō scriptæ sint recipiendæ: quæ autem semel definita, non debere in dubium revocari. Resp. Responsum est antea, ea tantùm fidem promereri atque assensum, quæ sunt definita piè & rite ex scripturâ prophetica & apostolica. His adde Bernhardum, qui epist.95.

Ad illud, inquit, concilium toto desiderio feror, in quo traditiones nō obstinaciùs defensantur, nec superstitiosius.{27} Veteris ecclesiæ doctores solitos esse allegare consensum ecclesiæ & traditiones apostolicas, quæ exstant in primorum patrum scriptis. Ita Irenæum opposuisse Florino testimonium patrum, qui ipsum antecesserunt, & comprimis Polycarpi, qui fuerat discipulus Johannis Euangelistæ & auditor apostolorum. Similiter à Basilio al-legari

page.notes: The left margin strip is cropped by the scan edge; its note text could not be read, so only placeholders are given, one per visible note group. Reference marks {26} and {27} are printed in the text; their notes are in the cropped margin. The foot "H" is a gathering signature, and "legari" is the catchword. The small notes at the left edge were not legible enough to transcribe. Paragraph break before "Ad illud" is inferred from the indent.
